subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Should automatic daily and idle rollover establish a new documented session:reset internal-hook contract while also invoking the existing typed before_reset plugin hook, or should one existing surface exclusively own reset persistence?
rationale: Both hook systems intentionally serve different users, and selecting the permanent event name, context, ordering, and ownership is a compatibility-sensitive API decision that should not be inferred from an unmerged contributor implementation.

options.title: Canonical reset lifecycle event
options.body: Create one internal reset lifecycle fact and adapt it to session:reset plus the existing typed before_reset hook before transcript archival.

options.title: Typed plugin hook only
options.body: Make before_reset the sole runtime contract and move bundled persistence behind a plugin-owned path rather than adding another internal event.

options.title: Reuse command events
options.body: Emit synthetic command events for daily and idle rollover, minimizing new API surface but permanently mixing command and lifecycle semantics.

recommendation.title: Canonical reset lifecycle event
recommendation.body: Create one internal reset lifecycle fact and adapt it to session:reset plus the existing typed before_reset hook before transcript archival.

likelyOwner.reason: The related PR identifies vincentkoc as the hooks/plugins CODEOWNER, making this the strongest available owner signal for the lifecycle API choice.
